# Dexmedetomidine


Dexmedetomidine is a central α~2~-agonist (α~2~:α~1~ activity 1600:1) used for its sedation and analgesic properties.

```{r}
source("scripts/drugtables.R")

DrugTable("dexmedetomidine")
```
